title: Shabbir ye kehte hai na ghabrayiyo zainab
body:
SHABBIR YE KEHTE HAIN NA GHABRAIYO ZAINAB
Lo Sham-e-gharebaa’n ke Alamdar tumhi ho
Is qafile ki qafila saalar tumhi ho
Bacho ki khabar lijiyo behlaiyo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaimo’n mein lage aag to abid ko jagana
Chhin jaye rida sar se to aansoo na bahana
Qaidi bhi banaye to chali jaaiyo Zainab
Khojaye Sakina to use dhoond ke lana
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho baap ke seene pa to aahista uthana
Hum to na rahenge tumhi behlaiyo Zainab
Jab shaam ke bazaar se sar nange guzarna
Ghabrake sitam se kabhi faryad na karna
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas bhai ka sar dekhke rehjaiyo Zainab
Roegi meri yaad mein din raat Sakina
Marjayegi Zindaan mein ghut ghutke Sakina
Zindaan mein masoom ko dafnaiyo Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaid-e-Sitam shaam se jab chhoot ke jana
Roodad-e-Alam Nana ke rauze pa sunana
Durro ke nashaa’n Amma ko dikhlaiyo Zainab
